xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex2101-2024-10-02-17-1933" status="finalized">'di dgag pa la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre chen</rs><note>"'bre chen" is taken to refer to 'Bre shes rab 'bar, rather than gTsang pa 'bre sgur.</note> na re de ni mi rigs te | <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3749">rgyud bla ma</rs> las ji skad du | <quote source="db:3749"><lg><l>so so'i skye bo phyin ci log ||</l> <l>bden pa mthong pa bzlog pa ste ||</l> <l>phyin ci ma log phyin ci log ||</l> <l>de bzhin gshegs pa ji lta bzhin ||</l> <l>phyin ci ma <lb edRef="inst:4622" n="51a7"/> log spros pa med ||</l></lg></quote> ces gsungs pa dang | de'i don kyang <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3748">dbus dang mtha' rnam par 'byed pa</rs> las | <quote source="db:3748"><lg><l>rjes su mthun pa phyin ci log ||</l> <l>rjes su 'brel bcas bzlog pa dang ||</l> <l>phyin ci ma log phyin ci log ||</l> <l>rjes su 'brel med bsgom pa'o ||</l></lg></quote> zhes gsungs pas so so' sgya bor bsgom pa ni 'phags pa'i bden pa mthong bar rtogs pa phyin ci ma log par <pb n="51b"/><lb edRef="inst:4622" n="51b1"/> bsgom pa dang rjes su mthun pa phyin ci log tu gyur pa yin pas phyin ci log gis phyin ci log spang par mi nus pa'i phyir ro zhes zer ro ||</seg></TEI>
source: 1_021_01_ gZhon nu rin chen_mngon par rtog pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel ba bcud kyi thig le.xml
